title: Wallet
description: Wire shapes of the wallet route (M8.1, ADR-080; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 4 and 6). Money is in whole micro-credits: 1,000,000 is one credit. Each message is a definition under $defs.

LedgerReason.description: What a ledger entry is for: a play-money credit grant, or the charge for a mesh or solve job (ADR-033).

LedgerJob.description: The job a charge is for: the machine size and rate it was queued with and the seconds billed (ADR-033).

ratePerHour.description: Micro-credits per hour of billable time.

LedgerRun.description: The run a solve charge paid for.

LedgerMesh.description: The mesh a mesh charge paid for. A mesh belongs to a geometry and may serve several simulations (ADR-047), so it is named by its geometry. Counts are null when meshing failed.

WalletEntry.description: One ledger entry, as the append-only ledger holds it, with what it paid for. amount is negative for a charge; balance is the balance after the entry. job, run and mesh are null where they do not apply.

WalletView.description: The signed-in user's wallet: the balance (the last entry's balance, 0 with no entries), what was granted and charged in all, and every ledger entry, newest first. granted + charged equals balance.

charged.description: The sum of the charges, zero or negative.

selfHosted.description: True in self-hosting mode (M8.10, ADR-084): jobs are still metered and charged to the ledger, but the wallet is informational and a balance refuses no run or mesh.
